artboards.title: J1 · First run: three questions as chips
J2 · Building: stages in chat, searches ticking in canvas
J4 · Job detail, Back to feed
J5 · Check fit from a card: a new application conversation
J6 · Edit feed view, first-visit nudge
J7 · Free tier: top 5, one upgrade line

annotations.text:
Flow 3, the Job Feed. Locked 19 Aug 2026 with Wasim: layout A (list in canvas + feed conversation), card A (one gold Check fit, Details link at the end of the summary, whole card clickable), setup A (chips in the chat), edit A (canvas view with Back).

Row 1: first run, building, the daily feed, a job's detail. Row 2: check fit from a card, Edit feed, the free tier.
J1: the feed's own conversation asks the three things it can't read from the CV, as chips or one typed line. The canvas waits: 'Your feed lands here'.

J2: four named stages in the chat; the canvas shows the ten searches ticking off with how many roles each found. Work is visible while it runs (rule 4). No 'feed ready' modal afterwards: J3's message is the announcement.

J3: the assistant announces the run with chips (Why Avetta first? Only remote. Raise my salary floor). Cards: badge, title, company, chips, two-line summary ending in a subtle 'Details →', one gold 'Check fit · 0.5', quiet Save and Employer site. Click anywhere on the card for detail.
J4: detail replaces the list in the canvas with 'Back to feed'. One gold Check fit, 'generate the kit' as a text link, 'Why it's a match' before the ad.

J5: Check fit from a card creates the application in the sidebar (Avetta · Now) and switches to its conversation, where the fit runs exactly as in flow 1. The canvas keeps the CV with a gold banner. The feed stays one click away in the sidebar.

J6: Edit feed is a canvas view with Back and three pills. On the first visit, after about three seconds, Searches and Preferences get a gold dot and a soft pulse so they aren't overlooked, plus a one-line hint card. The nudge shows once. Anything here can also be changed by asking in the chat.
J7: Free shows the top 5 in the same layout with no Edit feed and one upgrade line at the end of the list ('9 more roles matched today'). Same cards, same prices.
